source: Latest parent delegation conveys newer user-provided AGENTS.md restriction and directly instructs this integrator to pause main merge and related cleanup/local sync.
controlling_instruction: 当前先继续按整改分支范围完成最终复审接收、依赖核验与累计回归；本轮不合并 main、不提前关闭仍有依赖的问题；暂停此前计划中的 main 合并及相关清理/本地同步。
allowed_remaining_work: Receive exact U03/U06 independent result bundles without duplicate task creation
Verify fixed identities, scope, independent reviewer and substantive verdicts
Check final cumulative preservation and exact outstanding dependencies/regressions
Close only individually satisfied required gates; leave any unmet gate open
Commit and normally push remediation branch; publish final evidence and remaining limits

supersedes.effect: Historical authorization remains evidence only; its prospective main-merge permission is revoked for this round by the later instruction. No historical receipt deleted or rewritten.

AGENTS_provenance.qualification: Checked local tracked AGENTS; its current bytes do not contain the newer main restriction. This child received the latest restriction through the parent delegation, whose direct instruction is controlling. No unprovided AGENTS file hash/content is invented.

limits: No semantic/result credit from scheduling; all behavior NOT_EXECUTED, runtime0, model configuration UNVERIFIED, L01-L14 retained; optional/policy not adopted
